# Diplomatic Transcription: Archivio di Stato di Firenze, Mediceo del Principato 384, c. 78r-v
# Cyphersolver Unsolved Catalogue No. 2339 (Cardinal Alessandro Farnese to Pier Luigi Farnese, late July 1547)
# Source scans: ASFi DeepZoom native-max 2000x2829 px (0166_C_078_R.ptif, 0167_C_078_V.ptif; PAD unit 969, id 513466)
#
# Diplomatic conventions:
#   [a/b]     = paleographically ambiguous digit(s), best visual reading listed first
#   {dot:X}   = ink dot directly above digit X
#   {bar:X}   = horizontal overbar / macron above digit(s) X
#   {hat:X}   = curved arch / circumflex cap above digit X
#   {^XX}     = superscript insertion written above a caret mark
#   ,         = comma / diagonal tick below-right of preceding digit
#   <<...>>   = inline clear Italian text or scribal flourish
#
# Peer-review amendments from the blind pre-decode freeze (2,243 digits -> 2,244 digits, 19 Nov 2026):
#   1. L09 inline clear text: amended from blind draft <<et per [S.S./ff] s'intendí [E.S./S.S.]>>
#      to <<et perch[e] s'intend[e] ch[e]>> (looped terminal ch[e] ligature matches L23 ch[e] si potra).
#   2. L10 overbarred group at x=600-620: amended from blind {bar:6} to {bar:68} (compressed 68 under
#      overbar, visually confirmed on scan by independent reviewer; witness key 68̄ = Ferrara).
#   3. L22 uncancelled 0 before {^51}: retained diplomatically as written on scan (likely scribal
#      false start for 07 = d superseded by caret insertion {^51} = d).
#
# === c. 78r HEADER ===
# [Top-left]:  Copia (with upward-right diagonal underline flourish)
# [Top-right]: ~~75.~~ (struck through) / 78 (modern archival foliation below)
# [Note]:      Faint text visible between "Copia" and "D'una littera..." is physical show-through
#              from c. 79r ("Copia d'un Cap.lo d'una lra di Roma de 7. d'Agosto 1547."), NOT written on c. 78r.
# [Heading]:   D'una littera del Card^{le} Farnese
#
